title: Elephant holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Elephant body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="28" ry="22" fill="#8ab4d8"/>
  <!-- Elephant head -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="45" r="20" fill="#9fc5e8"/>
  <!-- Ear left -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="40" rx="10" ry="14" fill="#7ba7cc"/>
  <!-- Ear right -->
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="40" rx="10" ry="14" fill="#7ba7cc"/>
  <!-- Inner ear left -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="40" rx="6" ry="9" fill="#b3d4f0"/>
  <!-- Inner ear right -->
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="40" rx="6" ry="9" fill="#b3d4f0"/>
  <!-- Eye left -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="42" r="5" fill="#2d5a7b"/>
  <circle cx="33.5" cy="40.5" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Eye right -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="42" r="5" fill="#2d5a7b"/>
  <circle cx="47.5" cy="40.5" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Trunk -->
  <path d="M34 55 Q30 70 38 78 Q42 82 46 78 Q49 74 46 68 Q44 64 46 58" fill="#9fc5e8" stroke="#7ba7cc" stroke-width="2.5" fill-opacity="1"/>
  <!-- Trunk tip highlight -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="76" r="3" fill="#b3d4f0"/>
  <!-- Tusk left -->
  <path d="M30 58 Q26 64 28 68" stroke="#f0e6d0" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Tusk right -->
  <path d="M46 58 Q50 64 48 68" stroke="#f0e6d0" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="32" y="80" width="10" height="14" rx="4" fill="#7ba7cc"/>
  <rect x="56" y="80" width="10" height="14" rx="4" fill="#7ba7cc"/>
  <!-- Front leg -->
  <rect x="38" y="82" width="9" height="12" rx="4" fill="#9fc5e8"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M76 62 Q85 60 86 70" stroke="#7ba7cc" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Heart held by trunk -->
  <path d="M54 72 C54 66 62 64 64 70 C66 64 74 66 74 72 C74 80 64 86 64 86 C64 86 54 80 54 72 Z" fill="#e8456b"/>
  <!-- Heart highlight -->
  <path d="M60 69 C60 66 64 65 66 68" stroke="#ff7a9a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Toes -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="92" r="2" fill="#b3d4f0"/>
  <circle cx="39" cy="92" r="2" fill="#b3d4f0"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="92" r="2" fill="#b3d4f0"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="92" r="2" fill="#b3d4f0"/>
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="50" r="4" fill="#f0a0b0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="4" fill="#f0a0b0" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
